WaveGame_GetVersion
inline u8 WaveGame_GetVersion()
View source

Get the version of the MSX PICO WaveGame firmware Note that WaveGame version 1 is needed

Return

WaveGame version

0: Firmware v1.49 / v2.05 / v2.06
1: Firmware v1.50 / v2.07 and higher
